set.body:
Build the executable comparison boundary without contaminating foundation dependencies.

Acceptance criteria:
AC-432-01: The unpublished runner reads and writes required fixtures through image4s-nifti and invokes the canonical reframe4s-motion public pipeline.
AC-432-02: Pinned AFNI 3dvolreg and FSL MCFLIRT adapters capture corrected images, matrices, stage times, stdout, stderr, tool metadata, and failures. Optional comparators use the same result schema.
AC-432-03: Independent convention fixtures prove every adapter's input-to-reference or reference-to-input conversion against physical landmark mappings on nontrivial affines.
AC-432-04: All methods receive equivalent frames, masks, reference selection, thread limits, and declared interpolation or resampling opportunities; unavoidable differences are recorded, not hidden.
AC-432-05: The runner emits deterministic raw per-frame results and aggregate JSON or CSV with schema validation, checksums, and no silent skips.
AC-432-06: A small hermetic smoke fixture runs in ordinary CI without external proprietary data; full courts are separately scheduled or manually dispatched.
set.title: Implement pinned NIfTI comparator adapters and the matched benchmark runner
